question: Can Gemma 4 E2B IT run a protocol-v2 canonical Android campaign through a physically proven QNN HTP route on the authorized SM8550 phone?

scope.model: Gemma 4 E2B IT text generation only
excluded: accepting licenses or downloading another QAIRT SDK

model_identity.architecture: Gemma4 E2B: 35 layers, 1536 hidden size, interleaved sliding-window/global attention, per-layer embeddings, shared KV layers
model_identity.architecture_source: Qualcomm AI Hub Models v0.61.0 model.py at commit 5975a79b55b40f5cbc61f3ac5e52abe47d9d8bd5

selected_public_checkpoint.publisher: Qualcomm AI Hub Models public asset store
selected_public_checkpoint.sha256_null_reason: Download is deferred until heavy-ram.lock is acquired.
selected_public_checkpoint.quantization: w4a16 calibrated checkpoint; exact encoding inventory pending archive inspection

intentional_cpu_boundaries: embedding and per-layer embedding LUT lookup/requantization
candidate_route.direct_gguf_route_rejected: The public Google GGUF identifies architecture gemma4, while the installed QAIRT direct GGUF builder supports only llama, mistral, phi3, qwen2, qwen3, gemma, gemma2, and gemma3.

tokenizer_and_template.status: must be bound from the selected checkpoint archive before conversion

required_provider_proof.compiled_context_identity: Hash every deployed serialized context and bind its SM8550/HTP compiler metadata.
required_provider_proof.runtime_binding: Retain QnnHtp backend config, verbose Genie/QNN logs, loaded HTP host/stub/v73 skeleton libraries, and HTP profile evidence.
required_provider_proof.partition_boundary: Transformer prompt and token graphs must be wholly accepted by HTP. Any unsupported graph, CPU QNN backend, or undocumented transformer fallback is fatal.
required_provider_proof.cpu_boundary_disclosure: Tokenizer, LUT lookup/requantization, sampler, and orchestration CPU work remains explicit and is not misreported as HTP execution.
required_provider_proof.no_silent_cpu_only: A successful text response without the physical provider proof above is not QNN/HTP evidence.

campaign_gate.phone_priority: follows coordinated GPU paths; no ADB until Pi explicitly grants priority
campaign_gate.request_isolation_candidate: One loaded Genie Engine with a fresh Dialog per logical request, or a proven full GenieDialog_reset; measure reset/creation separately and reject retained KV/prefix reuse.
campaign_gate.memory: 100 ms target process PSS and VmHWM sampling across setup and campaign; HTP memory only when directly observable.
campaign_gate.cleanup: Remove and verify only /data/local/tmp/vibevoice-0031-gemma-4-e2b-it-android-qnn-htp while holding phone.lock.

fatal_gates: wrong model, checkpoint, tokenizer, template, workload, target, runtime, compiled context, or device identity
prompt plus 2048 ceiling exceeds context or any silent truncation
transformer graph is not fully bound to physical HTP or provider/fallback evidence is ambiguous
model/context remap, HTP recompilation, or retained prompt/KV state between canonical logical requests
unauthorized SDK/license/auth/device operation or lock violation
raw output cannot be bound to the claimed request and route
nullable_not_fatal: runtime timing splits not exposed by authoritative callbacks/profile data
HTP-private memory unavailable to process sampling
nonessential warnings that do not invalidate route identity or logical requests
